entities.name: PMID:25449029
observations: Rat maternal-obesity study profiling utero-placental compartments and fetal liver at gestational day 18.5, with thyroid-related gene assays in placenta, fetus, and weanling offspring.

entities.name: Obesity thyroid signaling changes
observations: Maternal obesity was associated with downregulation of multiple thyroid-hormone signaling components in placental junctional zone and fetal liver, and persistent altered expression of thyroid-related genes in offspring; placental Trh, Dio2, Trα, and Ucp2 correlated negatively with maternal leptin.
